name: CTID ATT&CK ↔ NIST SP 800-53 r5 Mapping
owner: Center for Threat-Informed Defense (CTID) — MITRE Engenuity
description: Mapping between NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls and MITRE ATT&CK 14.1 Enterprise techniques. Bidirectional: maps controls to techniques they mitigate, and techniques to controls that counter them.
relationToCloudSecurity: Useful for federal agencies and FedRAMP consumers translating between 800-53 controls and ATT&CK techniques.

current_extraction.notes: Reference-only. Upstream publishes this mapping at mappings/nist_800_53/attack-14.1/ and retains prior versions (attack-8.2, attack-9.0, attack-10.1, attack-12.1, attack-14.1, attack-16.1). Fetch from upstream rather than relying on a copy here.

extraction_history.reason: Removed the committed mapping and reverted to reference-only, matching this document's already-declared desired_end_state. The snapshot mapped ATT&CK 14.1 against a current 19.2, and upstream retains every version we held (attack-8.2, attack-9.0, attack-10.1, attack-12.1, attack-14.1, attack-16.1) plus newer ones. Files remain in git history and S3.

scope.upstream_versions_available: attack-8.2, attack-9.0, attack-10.1, attack-12.1, attack-14.1, attack-16.1

desired_end_state.notes: CTID mappings are Apache-2.0 and published upstream with prior versions retained (attack-8.2, attack-9.0, attack-10.1, attack-12.1, attack-14.1, attack-16.1), so a copy here drifts without adding anything. Stub points upstream.
